picker.heading: Want a little guidance?
picker.subheading: Pick a topic to get gentle prompts, or write freely.

freeform.label: Freeform
freeform.description: No prompts — just write what's on your mind.

difficult_conversation.label: Difficult conversation
difficult_conversation.description: Untangle a conversation that's weighing on you.
questions: What happened, in your own words?
What did you feel during and after the conversation?
What do you wish you had said or done differently?
What's one small step you could take from here?

energy_drain.label: Energy drain
energy_drain.description: Notice what's pulling your energy down.
questions: Where in your body or mood did you notice it?
What need of yours wasn't being met?
What's one thing that could help you recharge?

gratitude_win.label: Gratitude / a win
gratitude_win.description: Savor something good, big or small.
questions: What went well today, even something small?
Who or what are you grateful for right now?
What did you do that you're proud of?
How can you carry this feeling forward?

today.subtitleNone: A blank page today — that’s fine too.

What are you pretending not to notice?

hero.headline: Think out loud. Aura keeps up.
hero.body: It asks the next question instead of giving you the answer.
hero.photoCaption: photograph — one person, window light, b/w
hero.openerQuote: "You have described that job three times without once saying what you like about it."

talk.title: A conversation, not a script
talk.body: It reads the mood you write in, and says so.

catch.title: Keep the sentence that lands
catch.body: Keep the sentence that lands. It becomes a pattern.
catch.example: I stay quiet in rooms where I have the most to lose.

mirror.title: Four views of yourself
mirror.body: Open, blind, hidden, unknown — kept live.

people.title: Who you keep talking about
people.body: Who you keep naming — and who went quiet.
people.example: Ba — 31 days since he came up

timeline.title: A log, not a feeling
timeline.body: Every noticing keeps its date, its category and the energy you had that day — so patterns show up on their own.

values.title: What you will not trade away
values.body: Choose from twelve. Aura uses them to notice when you are talking yourself out of something that matters.

why.label: Why it works
why.title: Leading yourself comes before leading anyone else.
why.subtitle: Every feature above belongs to one layer of that model. Nothing in Aura exists because it demoed well.

layer0.title: Your values
layer0.body: The ground you judge everything else against.

layer1.title: Talk · Mirror
layer1.body: Naming what is happening inside, in your own words.

layer3.title: The people in it
layer3.body: Where the inside meets everyone you have to deal with.

layer5.title: Catch · Timeline
layer5.body: What you keep, and what it adds up to over months.

closing.title: Say the thing you keep circling.
